name: Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd. operates as a securities company in China. It offers wealth management services, such as transaction service system, financial product and services system, and fintech platform; and capital intermediary services, including margin trading, securities lending and borrowing, stock-pledged repurchase transactions, repurchase agreements, and equity incentive financing, as well as option financing and coupon source position occupancy services. The company also provides income certificates and trust plans, securities investment funds, securities asset management plans, insurance asset management products, and futures asset management products; buyback offering product;…
